title: Brake squeaking noise
description: Squeaking noise occurs when the brake pedal is pressed at low speed

title: Brake pedal vibration
description: The brake pedal vibrates during braking especially at highway speed

title: Reduced braking performance
description: The vehicle requires a longer stopping distance than usual

title: Engine overheating
description: The engine temperature rises above the normal range after extended driving

title: Engine oil warning light
description: The engine oil warning light remains illuminated after startup

title: Engine rough idle
description: The engine shakes and runs unevenly while the vehicle is stationary

title: Battery not charging
description: The battery warning light is displayed and the battery does not charge while driving

title: Battery drains overnight
description: The vehicle battery loses charge after the car is parked overnight

title: Starter motor failure
description: The engine does not crank and a clicking sound is heard when starting

title: Air conditioning not cooling
description: The air conditioning system blows warm air even at the lowest temperature setting

title: Weak cabin airflow
description: Airflow from the dashboard vents is significantly weaker than normal

title: Heating system failure
description: The cabin remains cold even when the heating system is enabled

title: Steering wheel vibration
description: The steering wheel vibrates while driving at higher speeds

title: Vehicle pulls to one side
description: The vehicle moves toward one side while driving on a straight road

title: Suspension knocking noise
description: A knocking sound comes from the suspension when driving over uneven roads

title: Transmission shifting delay
description: There is a noticeable delay when the automatic transmission changes gears

title: Transmission slipping
description: The engine speed increases but the vehicle does not accelerate normally

title: Clutch slipping
description: The engine speed rises without a corresponding increase in vehicle speed

title: Tire pressure warning
description: The tire pressure monitoring warning remains active after the tires are inflated

title: Uneven tire wear
description: One or more tires show significantly greater wear on one side

title: Wheel bearing noise
description: A humming or grinding noise increases as vehicle speed increases

title: Headlight failure
description: One of the front headlights does not illuminate when switched on

title: Brake light failure
description: A rear brake light does not illuminate when the brake pedal is pressed

title: Dashboard display failure
description: The digital dashboard display is blank or intermittently switches off

title: Parking sensor malfunction
description: The parking sensors continuously beep even when no obstacle is present

title: Rear camera unavailable
description: The rear-view camera image does not appear when reverse gear is selected

title: Lane assist unavailable
description: The lane-keeping assistance system displays an unavailable warning

title: Windshield wiper failure
description: The windshield wipers do not move when activated

title: Washer fluid not spraying
description: No washer fluid reaches the windshield when the washer system is activated

title: Door lock malfunction
description: One vehicle door does not lock or unlock using the central locking system
